description: 筑紫野市 避難場所・避難所(福岡都市圏共通フォーマット) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 筑紫野市. 福岡市の避難場所・避難所を福岡都市圏各自治体で共通化したフォーマットにしたデータです。. Coverage: 筑紫野市. The portal files it under the publisher 筑紫野市. Its tags are 位置情報, 共通フォーマット, 施設, 災害, 筑紫野市. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, pdf. The portal shows 2020-10-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
